note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content. The transcript and the DDx JSON were not provided.

Please paste:
- The full transcript text (doctor-patient conversation)
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) JSON

Once I have those, I will produce a structured SOAP note using American English, with:
- Subjective
- Objective
- Assessment & Plan (with up to as many issues as present in the transcript, each including: diagnosis name, consistent DDx (from DDx only), planned investigations, treatments, and referrals)
- Quality checks (as specified)

Here is the exact structure I will follow (ready to fill once you provide the data):

Subjective:
- Current issues, reasons for visit, and history of presenting complaints (onset, duration, progression)
- Past medical history, previous surgeries (if applicable)
- Medications (if applicable; with dose/route/frequency if provided; otherwise note “dose/route/frequency not documented.”)
- Social history (if applicable)
- Allergies (if applicable)

Objective:
- Physical or mental state examination findings (include site, side, details)
- Investigations with results (if applicable)

Assessment & Plan:

1. Issue, Problem, or Request 1 (issue/request/condition name only):
   - Assessment or likely diagnosis for Issue 1 (condition name only)
   - Differential diagnosis for Issue 1 (DDx items only if consistent with transcript; include likelihood tags if available)
   - Investigations planned for Issue 1 (if applicable)
   - Treatment planned for Issue 1 (if applicable)
   - Relevant referrals for Issue 1 (if applicable)

2. Issue, Problem, or Request 2:
   - (same sub-bullets as above)

3. Issue, Problem, or Request 3:
   - (same sub-bullets as above)

Quality checks (always include at bottom of note, or fill document_quality):
- Missing but clinically expected elements for a consult (e.g., allergies, meds reconciliation)
- Internal conflicts between transcript and DDx (mark “conflict noted”)
- Brief comment on transcript quality if noisy/inaudible

If you either resend the transcript and DDx or attach them, I’ll generate the complete note right away.
